component.name: ValidateEpgTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "validateEpg" end sub
sub validateEpg() m.top.state = "loading"
url = m.top.url if url = invalid then url = "" url = TrimString(url) if url = "" m.top.error = "No EPG URL provided." m.top.state = "error" return end if
validationCacheKey = "epg_validate" ClearCachedKey(validationCacheKey) session = LoadAccountSession() useProxy = IsLikelyRawGzip(url, "") if IsMasterJapanKoreaGuide(url) result = FetchMasterJapanKoreaGuide() else if useProxy and IsProFeatureEnabled("epg_proxy") and session.accessToken <> invalid and session.accessToken <> "" result = HttpGetWithAuth(BuildEpgProxyUrl(session.apiBaseUrl, url), validationCacheKey, 0, session.accessToken) else result = HttpGet(url, validationCacheKey, 0) end if if not result.ok ClearCachedKey(validationCacheKey) m.top.error = "Failed to download EPG. " + IIF(result.error <> invalid, result.error, "Check URL or network.") m.top.state = "error" return end if
epgData = ParseXMLTV(result.body) ClearCachedKey(validationCacheKey) if epgData = invalid or epgData.channels = invalid or epgData.channels.Count() = 0 errorMsg = "No XMLTV channels found. Check that the URL points to valid guide data." if IsLikelyRawGzip(url, result.body) errorMsg = "Roku could not parse this .xml.gz file. Use a plain XMLTV URL or serve gzip with decompression headers." end if m.top.error = errorMsg m.top.state = "error" return end if
programmeCount = 0 if epgData.programmes <> invalid then programmeCount = epgData.programmes.Count()
m.top.summary = { channelCount: epgData.channels.Count(), programmeCount: programmeCount } SafeLog("EPG", "Validated EPG source: " + RedactUrl(url) + " channels=" + Str(epgData.channels.Count()).Trim()) m.top.state = "done" end sub
function IsLikelyRawGzip(url as String, body as Dynamic) as Boolean if EndsWith(LCase(url), ".gz") or EndsWith(LCase(url), ".xml.gz") then return true if body <> invalid and Len(body) >= 2 return Asc(Mid(body, 1, 1)) = 31 and Asc(Mid(body, 2, 1)) = 139 end if return false end function
